feedback: Approved to race unchanged. Iteration 1 (365.78, the best so far) shows the design completes the oval (17 of 20 runs, finish about 1.92 s, max_error 0.044 m) but leaves the track on the s-bend (19 of 20, max_error 0.0613 m, just past the 0.06 m limit) and the slalom (20 of 20, progress 0.117). Iteration 0 left the track on every run at base_speed 1.6 with kp 2.0, so speed and gain both mattered. This candidate changes four things at once: base_speed 1.3 to 1.1, sensor span widened to x = +/-0.08, sensors moved forward to y = 0.07, and kd 0.5 to 0.6. Each change targets a failure seen in the telemetry, and all values are inside the contract. Because four changes were made together, the race cannot separate their effects, so the next critique should use per-track results to attribute them. The oval should still finish comfortably under the 3.0 s limit at 1.1, based on the 1.92 s finish at 1.3. Approving now uses one action run for the race and keeps budget for a revision round if the telemetry points to a clear fix. After the race, read the results as follows. If the s-bend and slalom still end off track with max_error at or above 0.06 m, first try base_speed 1.0 to 0.9, since speed was the strongest lever in iterations 0 and 1. If the oval no longer finishes or completion_time exceeds 3.0 s, raise base_speed in steps of 0.1 to 1.2. If line_loss_events remain above zero on the slalom, test controller.line_loss at search_left or search_right, matching the side the robot leaves the line.
requested_changes: If the s-bend or slalom still end off track with max_error at or above 0.06 m, lower controller.base_speed to 1.0 or 0.9. Speed reduced the error from iteration 0 to iteration 1, so it remains the strongest lever.

If the oval fails to finish or completion_time rises above 3.0 s, raise controller.base_speed in steps of 0.1 (to 1.2) while keeping the wider sensor span, since the oval finished at 1.92 s at base_speed 1.3.

If geometry.sensor_positions still show line loss on the slalom (line_loss_events above 0.2 from iteration 1), test controller.line_loss at search_left or search_right, matching the side the robot leaves the line.
